scope: Actual local HTTP and Chromium; production services not exercised

policy.destinations: Any HTTP(S) URL; no per-service destination configuration
paths: API client and explicit API replay

checks: Multiple services and URL paths with no HTTP configuration
Obsolete empty and restrictive settings ignored
Actual upstream HTTP failure without automatic retries
Collection preflight and execution without configuration
Live HTTP scenario GET/HEAD capture
URL shape, read-only capture and redirect semantics

coverage.gate: Passed against retained preceding complete full-suite baseline; no floors lowered

checks: Opening services and cached Consul targets sends no service requests
Route → Consul URL → runtime path variable → query/headers → backend send → retained pretty JSON
Replica changes update URL and clear a bearer profile that no longer matches
Manual base URL overrides are honored by backend execution
Save to nested collections and reopen an editable request without executing it
Multi-step workflows are explicitly directed to Scripts instead of silently flattening them
JSON request bodies are edited and sent, with actual 201 results
HTTP failures stay inspectable responses
Cancel releases the client and forwards cancellation to backend HTTP
Text/HTML responses render safely as text
Environment changes replace the service target with the selected environment’s Consul evidence
Scoped history reopens retained responses without replay
Route pagination exposes every endpoint beyond the first 100
Tab sets support keyboard selection and labelled panels
Desktop, mobile and dark-theme layouts are captured without page overflow
Admin mounts the same client with its selected environment and task scope
